usage.file_list_schema: JSON array of explicit workspace-relative paths; --file PATH and --zip-manifest PATH may be repeated. The file-list and manifest JSON bytes are automatically text-scanned. No directory traversal or implicit repository enumeration.
usage.output_requirement: New exclusive output outside already frozen archive report roots. The example delivery directory/list/report are proposed, not created by this task.
preconditions: Root waits until intended files and ZIPs are terminal and quiet.
Root supplies every intended newly added/changed text file; list prior ZIP manifests separately if their payloads also need content scanning.
A and B must exist; the scanner independently verifies each selected container and every exact manifest member. It does not infer or recursively scan predecessor archives.
After scanning, root separately verifies staged binary blob SHA against these read-byte inventories and bound artifacts.

exit_codes.0: No unresolved pattern candidates within covered text; declared binary exclusions remain.
exit_codes.2: One or more unresolved candidates: manual redacted review required; pending gaps may also exist.
exit_codes.3: Incomplete scope or integrity/size/encoding/input error; cannot claim final clean scan.
exit_codes.4: Scanner/argument-output operation failed; no success claim.

limits.behavior: Bounds produce pending findings rather than silent success. Binary members are hash-verified but not credential-scanned. No extraction; ZIP text reads are bounded and every scan byte has an inventory SHA.

redaction.exception_policy: Fixed boundary reason codes or generic error type only; exception text from input parsers is not emitted.
redaction.authorization_prose_rule: Only the authorization field, whitespace plus explicit permission language, without a long token component or credential envelope; all other suspicious assignment values remain unresolved.
redaction.placeholder_rule: Only narrowly enumerated placeholder envelopes; a generic test/example prefix does not whitelist a credential-shaped value.

errors.reason: Eight synthetic tests passed on the recorded final source. Missing/malformed/oversized/integrity-failed inputs remain pending; unresolved candidates return nonzero. Output is exclusive and values are never included in normal scanner reports.

consistency.reason: Explicit files, metadata controls, and exact verified ZIP members are separately inventoried. Containers are rehashed after scanning, duplicate file uses must match bytes, member membership and SHA are checked before payload scanning; no Git-index or recursive-dependency scan is implied.

paper_topic.reason: Delivery hygiene only. The helper reads future explicitly selected terminal evidence without editing prompts, runtime, raw results, allocation math, study conditions, or interpretation.

limitations: Pattern scanning cannot prove every possible secret format absent.
Known binary extensions and unknown non-UTF8/NUL payloads are explicitly excluded; malformed declared text is pending.
No actual archive, result, raw/partial stream, service, or model was read in development.
Only an owner static review and synthetic execution are claimed here; independent review, if completed later, is separate.
